name: touchgrass-functions
description: Server-side Gemini photo verification + authoritative reward computation for TouchGrass. Not yet deployed — see functions/README.md.

scripts.test: npm run build && node ../tool/strict_node_test.mjs lib/rewards.test.js lib/accountDeletion.test.js lib/orphanPhotoCleanup.test.js lib/ops/ops.test.js lib/ops/ops7c.test.js lib/entryPoint.test.js lib/ops/readOnlyGuarantee.test.js
scripts.test:emulator: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --config ../firestore-tests/firebase.json --only firestore,storage,auth --project demo-touchgrass-fn "node ../tool/strict_node_test.mjs --test-concurrency=1 lib/accountDeletion.emulator.test.js lib/orphanPhotoCleanup.emulator.test.js lib/ops/ops.emulator.test.js lib/ops/ops7c.emulator.test.js"
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore,storage,auth --project demo-touchgrass-dev
scripts.shell: npm run build && firebase functions:shell --project demo-touchgrass-dev
